name: route53-recovery-cluster
description: Welcome to the Routing Control (Recovery Cluster) API Reference Guide for Amazon Route 53 Application Recovery Controller.

subcommands.name: get-routing-control-state
subcommands.description: Get the state for a routing control.

subcommands.name: list-routing-controls
subcommands.description: List routing control names and Amazon Resource Names (ARNs), as well as the routing control state for each routing control, along with the control panel name and control panel ARN for the routing controls.

subcommands.name: update-routing-control-state
subcommands.description: Set the state of the routing control to reroute traffic.
